title: Positivity of reciprocal perpendicular size
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $A$ be a linear subspace of $\\mathbb F_2^n$. The reciprocal of $2$ raised to the dimension of the orthogonal complement of $A$ (with respect to the standard dot product) is positive.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a linear subspace of $\\mathbb F_2^n$
